from pathlib import Path
import json
import sys
import tempfile

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT))

from control.model_execution.direct_sol_chat import (
    build_request, build_result, worker_policy_error
)
from control.model_execution.materialize_direct_sol import materialize

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="r4p2-plumbing-") as td:
    base=Path(td)
    req=build_request(
        task_id="PREFLIGHT-SOL-BUILD",
        phase="SOL_BUILD",
        campaign_id="FULL-A2Z-LIVE-20261004-V4",
        candidate_id="AUTO-DISCOVERY-54d13314c7879b58e46d",
        binding_sha256="b"*64,
        prompt="Synthetic plumbing-only Sol build response. No experiment execution.",
        delivery_route_task_id="SESSION-ROUTE-PREFLIGHT",
        created_at_utc="2026-10-07T14:35:00Z",
    )
    res=build_result(
        req,
        worker_route_task_id="SESSION-ROUTE-PREFLIGHT-WORKER",
        final='{"schema":"PREFLIGHT_ONLY","status":"OK"}',
        started_at_utc="2026-10-07T14:35:01Z",
        finished_at_utc="2026-10-07T14:35:02Z",
    )
    reqp=base/"request.json"; resp=base/"result.json"; runtime=base/"runtime"
    reqp.write_text(json.dumps(req),encoding="utf-8")
    resp.write_text(json.dumps(res),encoding="utf-8")
    env=materialize(reqp,resp,runtime)

    assert env["task_id"]=="PREFLIGHT-SOL-BUILD"
    assert env["phase"]=="SOL_BUILD"
    assert env["model"]=="gpt-5.6-sol"
    assert env["model_policy"]=="SOL_EXACT"
    assert env["execution_layer"]=="DIRECT_SOL_CHAT"

    run=runtime/env["checkpoint"]
    worker=json.loads((run/"WORKER.json").read_text())
    assert worker_policy_error(worker,"SOL_BUILD") is None
    assert set(p.name for p in run.iterdir())=={"TASK.json","WORKER.json","COMPLETE.json","events.jsonl"}

    bad=dict(worker); bad["execution_layer"]="CODEX_WORKER"
    assert worker_policy_error(bad,"SOL_BUILD")=="DIRECT_SOL_EXECUTION_REQUIRED"

    astra={
        "model":"gpt-6-astra",
        "model_selection":{"policy":"ASTRA_EXACT","selected_slug":"gpt-6-astra"},
        "execution_layer":"CODEX_WORKER",
        "command_flags":["exec","-m","gpt-6-astra"],
    }
    assert worker_policy_error(astra,"ASTRA_PREBUILD") is None
    astra_bad=dict(astra); astra_bad["model"]="gpt-5.6-sol"
    assert worker_policy_error(astra_bad,"ASTRA_PREBUILD")=="EXACT_MODEL_REQUIRED"

print("R4P2_POSTPREBUILD_PLUMBING_PREFLIGHT=PASS")
